title: refcheck rules show --json
description: One checkout's learned rules and where they live. A run naming no checkout from outside a git repository exits 128 and prints no document.

checkout.description: The checkout the rules belong to.

generated.description: When rules learn wrote the file.

time_window.description: How far back the history was read, in git log --since's terms.

file_mappings.description: An old filename to the one a rename gave it.
